## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `853ddedb4844c75351d2773fe4ee50091e4b1f2a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, AGENTS.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml + scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs, scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs, ci.yml jobs `filter` / `ui-deps` / `test-ui` / `test-gate` / `lint-ui` / `build-e2e-ui` (read, not reviewed), scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs (gate discovery only), .github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml `required-set-patrol`

Card #26460 read in full: body, brief 6433960457, ruling 6435318516 (letter A, staged), ui claim 6436277065, flake reading 6436579765 (0/50), ui os-dev-report 6436597045, devx claim 6436627175, devx os-dev-report 6437393268. Net diff read as `git diff f48aa451 pr/26569` (5 files, +119/-14); `origin/main` has moved three commits past the merge base and touches none of the five files, so the net diff is the merge diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Required-set change (the public surface of this PR): eight contexts become nine, `Test UI` added, nothing renamed or dropped.** Right. The registry row (`ci.yml` / `test-ui-gate` / `Test UI`) names the ruling, the flake reading and the maintainer's ruleset half; `RETIRED_CONTEXT_NAMES` is untouched because no existing literal moves. The nine literals in the registry, in `AGENTS.md` line 523–527 and in `platform-readings.md` line 390–392 are membership-identical (the gate's `statesTheSet` census compares count and `includes`, not order; the two prose surfaces place `Test UI` between `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` while the registry appends it last — order was already unaligned across the three before this PR and is not a gate input).
- **The `Test UI` verdict table agrees exactly with `test-ui`'s own `if:`.** `test-ui` runs iff `!cancelled() && ui_tree != 'false' && ui != 'false'`; it is therefore `skipped` only when (a) `ui_tree` or `ui` is the literal `'false'`, which only the filter step can produce (both outputs are `… || 'true'`), or (b) the run was cancelled. The gate passes `skipped` only on `filter == success && (ui_tree == 'false' || ui == 'false')`, i.e. exactly case (a). Every other rollup word reds. Judged right, case by case:
  - `filter` fails or is cancelled on a PR: its outputs are empty or `'true'`, every ui `if:` reads `!= 'false'` as true, `ui-deps` and `test-ui` RUN, the rollup is `success`/`failure`/`cancelled`, never `skipped`; a failed filter cannot manufacture a green skip. Right. On `merge_group` the paths-filter step is `continue-on-error`, so a failed diff there also runs every ui job. Right.
  - `ui-deps` fails or times out: `test-ui`'s `if:` reads only `cancelled()` and the filter outputs, so the shards still run (cold build, by that job's own comment) and the rollup carries a real verdict. Right.
  - Run-level cancellation: shards `skipped`, filter `success` with `ui='true'` ⇒ the gate reds on "unexplained skip". That is one deliberate divergence from `test-gate`, which lets a skipped leg pass when `filter` itself reads `cancelled` (#3668, pinned in check-shard-attestation's battery iv). Here the painted-red sha is a superseded push or an evicted queue entry, which no required check reads, and `always()` means the context is still published, so no pending state follows. Acceptable; noted in ④ as a should-fix comment, not a defect.
  - `cancelled` from a shard killed by its own `timeout-minutes`: red. Right (a timeout is not a pass).
  - Lifecycle words (`abandoned`): red via the `*)` arm. Right, and the maintainer's 2026-08-07 refusal to whitelist `abandoned` is honoured.
- **Can it leave the PR pending?** No. `if: always()` with `needs: [test-ui, filter]` publishes the `Test UI` context on every run that starts, whatever the two needs conclude; the only way to publish nothing is a workflow that does not parse, which reds every ci.yml context alike. Confirmed on the head: run 40475173899 published `Test UI` (check-run 122093355274) 3 s after the last shard, log line `rollup: 'success'; filter: 'success' (ui_tree='true', ui='true')`.
- **Can it pass a run where shards did not run for an unexplained reason?** No. The matrix is a static literal of 16 under one job-level `if:`, so the rollup cannot mix skipped and succeeded legs; a `success` rollup is 16 concluded successes, and a `skipped` rollup passes only with the filter's explicit `'false'`. The rollup blind spot `test-gate` closes with attestations (`abandoned` swallowing a sibling's `failure`, run 31114735713) is still open here in one direction: a lifecycle word reds rather than passes, so the failure mode is a false red, never a false green. Right for a first enrolment; the PR's acceptance note says why per-shard credentials are the ui lane's change, not this one's.
- **`check:aggregator-roster` floor gains `test-ui-gate`.** Right: members `test-ui` + non-members `filter` equals `needs:` in both directions; no `--leg` tokens in the step, so the leg cross-check is vacuous by design (the gate reads the rollup, not attestations). `check:shard-attestation` discovers gates by a `--verify` invocation, so `test-ui-gate` is outside its roster and its download-artifact requirement, correctly.
- **No other accept-set change.** The `ui` path filter already lists `.github/workflows/**`, so this PR itself (and every later workflow edit) runs the shards rather than skipping them; the new job adds about 10 s of serial wall after the last shard and no runner work. The `Live required-set sweep` is report-only (its header and `verifyRequiredSet` say so) and stays off the required path.
- **Check-runs on 853ddedb at the time of writing (2026-10-27 ~08:49Z).** Required contexts concluded `success`: `Test UI` (the new one, 122093355274), `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. Also `success`: all 16 `Test UI (k/16)`, `Build UI Deps`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Live required-set sweep`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` lane, `Test Core (2/8)` and `(3/8)`, the three claim/path guards. **Still in progress:** `Test Core (1/8)` and therefore the required `Test Core` aggregate, and the required `Lint UI`. No red anywhere. The landing waits for those two to conclude green (PD #14, Tier H), as it does for the approval.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct: the diff touches a workflow, two repo-root gate scripts and two instruction surfaces; no `packages/*` path, no published export, no schema. `Check Changeset` is green on the head. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the ruling's execution line (6435318516) and the claim (6436627175). No breaking arm, no ADR-0087 disposition owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag 1 — `AGENTS.md` and `platform-readings.md` edited without being named in the dispatch. **Judged the minimum the gate requires, and true.** Both are `statesTheSet: true` surfaces in `INSTRUCTION_SURFACES`; `judgeInstructionSurfaces` reds the registry PR itself when either fails to name every registry context (count and membership), so the list lines cannot be deferred to a follow-up. The edits are one list line each plus the hand-followed count words the same file's own ledger line says are unpinned (`⛔ 但数量词未钉`): `AGENTS.md` three lines in one paragraph (list, "those eight" ×2 → nine), `platform-readings.md` two lines (八个 → 九个, list). Nothing else in either file changed. Precedent #25857 / #25878 did the same two lines in the enrolment PR. The claim's "any doc the registry derives / only as far as the new row needs" covers it. The sentences are true on the head once the maintainer's ruleset half lands, which is the #9325 two-step the files already describe; see ④ for the ordering.
- Dev flag 2 — `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs` not in the claim's file surface. Strictly, the gate would not red without the `REQUIRED_AGGREGATORS` row (discovery is by declaration), so this is one row beyond "only as far as the new row needs"; but the file's own header says the floor is "kept in step with `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`", and an aggregate carrying a required context without a floor row is exactly the deletable-declaration hole the floor exists to close. One row plus two self-test controls. Accepted as the file's stated contract, not scope creep.
- Dev flag 3 — PR not subscribed for activity. Process note; nothing for this record.
- `open_questions`: `[]` on both os-dev-reports. Nothing to escalate.
- Ruling order honoured: the ui step's reading (6436579765, 0/50 on the newest 50 queue builds that ran Test UI, every red in 24 h fixed on `main`) is on the card and precedes the PR; the devx claim and report cite it; `authorized` in the registry row cites it. Staged as ruled.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; assignee `os-steve` mirrors the card. Branch `claude/project-thread-nsgh5p` is the branch the newest `Claim:` (6436627175) names; the `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` check is green.
- Tier: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `AGENTS.md` are Tier H rows of `GOVERNED_SURFACES`; the PR is draft awaiting a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` review, with `hotlong` and `os-zhuang` requested. This record is the Tier S half for the `.claude/**` path; it lifts nothing on its own for the Tier H paths and the landing stays the maintainer's or an authorized approval plus the owning seat.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`test-ui-gate`).** Holds against the code it cites. `name: Test UI` is the bare literal `check:required-contexts` pins, and the shards keep their suffixed `Test UI (k/16)` names so assertion 9's whole-name comparison passes (the new self-test case proves the collision reds). `if: always()` and `needs` including `filter` match the `test-gate` shape the ruling names (`ci.yml:1697` on this head), the roster declaration is exact, `timeout-minutes: 10` and `contents: read` are the minimal envelope for a one-step shell job, and the bracket form `needs['test-ui'].result` is the correct expression for a hyphenated id. Every sentence in the job comment is true on the head except one cosmetic spelling: the prose says `needs.test-ui.result` while the step reads `needs['test-ui'].result` (same value; should-fix for a later pass, not this PR). Should-fix, non-blocking: the comment could say in one clause that a skip under a cancelled `filter` reds here where `test-gate` passes it (#3668), so the next reader does not file that difference as a defect. Acceptance against the ruling: it is the aggregate letter A asked for, in the shape it named, after the ui reading it ordered first.
- **`AGENTS.md` (merge-queue rule, §7).** The edited paragraph is rules text, carries no new incident narrative or issue citation (the PR number convention and `pm-skill-id-lint` are respected), names the nine literals verbatim, and keeps "treat those nine names as contract". True on the head modulo the ruleset half. Order of names is not a gate input (see ①).
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (required-set ledger).** Same one-line change, count word followed by hand as its own next bullet instructs. True on the head modulo the ruleset half.
- **Landing order with the ruleset flip.** The queue-safe order is **merge first, flip second, in one sitting** (the #9325 two-step the registry's own comment prescribes, and the `Lint UI` / `Build & E2E UI` precedent). If the maintainer adds `Test UI` to the `main` ruleset BEFORE this PR merges, every PR head and every merge-queue entry built from a `ci.yml` without `test-ui-gate` never publishes a `Test UI` check-run and sits permanently pending — the #3622 deadlock, and it would stall the whole queue, this PR's own entry included (a merge-group build uses the group's merged workflow, but entries ahead of it do not). Between the merge and the flip the context is merely advisory, the `Live required-set sweep` reports direction A, and nothing stalls; that window is the harmless one. The #25870 overlap the claim names is in a different `ci.yml` section with no shared hunk; whichever lands second merges `origin/main` first per the claim.
- **`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` and `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`** (cited, read as one change with the rule). Registry row, two `mustName` entries, the `INSTRUCTION_SURFACES` history comment (7→8, 8→9) and three new self-test controls are consistent with the live gate behaviour described in ①; the dev reports both scripts and both `--self-test` batteries exit 0 on the head, and the `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` lane that carries them is green on the head. Should-fix, non-blocking, pre-existing: the roster header now says "Five of this repo's required contexts are aggregator jobs", but `Dogfood Regression Gate` is a tombstoned context since #22998 (full battery, not required), so the honest count of required aggregators is four plus one full-battery aggregate; the previous "Four" carried the same imprecision. A one-word follow-up in the devx lane, not a reason to hold the enrolment.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · devx seat 2 · 2026-10-27T08:50Z

Seat `domain:devx#2` (#20163) · `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9` · reviewed head `853ddedb` · card #26460 (claim 6436627175, branch `claude/project-thread-nsgh5p`), ruling 6435318516 letter A, staged. The ui lane's reading 6436579765 (0/50 flakes) came first, as the ruling ordered. Thread-read: none.

- **What it adds:** one `ci.yml` job, `test-ui-gate`, named `Test UI`, with `needs: [test-ui, filter]` and `if: always()`. It passes on `success`, and on `skipped` only when `filter` succeeded and said the diff reaches no ui path. Everything else reds. The job also gets one `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row naming the ruling and the reading, and one `REQUIRED_AGGREGATORS` row, each with self-test controls. No shard, timeout or filter change, and no Test Core line (so no overlap with #25870).
- **Deviation, accepted:** `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` were not named in the dispatch, but both are `statesTheSet` surfaces, and `check:required-contexts` reds the registry PR unless they name all nine. Each changes its one list line plus the count word, as #25857/#25878 did.
- **Contract review:** the `## Contract review` record above, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on `853ddedb4844`, is a PASS with no must-fix. Its two should-fixes are comment wording only and stay out of this PR.
- **CI at review time:** 53 success, 10 skipped, 0 red. `Test Core (1/8)` (so the `Test Core` aggregate) and `Lint UI` were still running. The new `Test UI` context already published green on this head (check-run 122093355274).

**Landing (Tier H: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `AGENTS.md`):** it stays a draft with auto-merge off until a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval. ⛔ Order matters: **merge first, then the maintainer adds `Test UI` to the `main` ruleset in the same sitting.** Adding it to the ruleset before this merges would leave every PR and queue entry whose `ci.yml` lacks the job pending forever (the #3622 deadlock). The card closes on `Fixes`.
